name: billpoodum-backend
description: BillPoodum API — Zoho Catalyst Advanced I/O function (Node.js). Source in TypeScript, bundled into catalyst/functions/api.

scripts.gen: node scripts/gen-schema.mjs && node scripts/gen-sqlite.mjs && node scripts/gen-checklist.mjs
scripts.build: node scripts/gen-schema.mjs && node scripts/gen-sqlite.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.dev: node scripts/gen-schema.mjs && node scripts/gen-sqlite.mjs && tsx watch src/local.ts
scripts.test: node scripts/gen-schema.mjs && node scripts/gen-sqlite.mjs && npm run test:sqlite && npm run test:hrana && npm run test:memory
